messages.subject: Area. Predictions to high?
parts:
Hi,

I have a model that appears to work very nicely ( according to chat values and bootstrap analysis).
I wanted to offset the area of my transect line.
When I used predict my values are a lot high then would be expected for this species.
Could I have made an error in my code while offsetting the transect size?

Thank you. Any help would be appreciated.

Ian
